steps.name: it is the emulator, not a stray device
Settings is really in the foreground
steps.comment: dumpsys window sometimes reports no focus mid-transition; the resumed activity is the reliable read.

steps.name: tap the search box by its label
steps.comment: By label, not coordinates: uiautomator knows where it is, and this survives a change of device or resolution.

steps.name: the search screen really opened
steps.comment: Clear text only exists once a search field has content, so it proves both the tap and the typing.

steps.name: the query really reached the search field
steps.comment: A freshly booted emulator has not finished indexing Settings, so assert on the field, not on results.
